## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the containment check in `preview` before merge: it compares paths as text without resolving them, so a relative path with `..` can read any file the process can read.

## Changes
This pull request adds `preview(home, relative)` to `app/paths.py`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under the home directory, and adds `settings_file(home)`, which returns the settings path. It also adds tests for both helpers and a new `tests/review-note.txt` file.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../../etc/passwd")` passes the check and returns that file's contents. `Path.is_relative_to` only compares path parts as text, and `home/../../etc/passwd` still starts with `home`; a symlink inside home that points outside it gets through the same way. The added test at `tests/test_paths.py:20` only tries an absolute path, so this case is never tested. — Anyone who controls `relative` can read files outside the selected home directory. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, then add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
